closed_items.title: Termux shell profile trusts an inherited sentinel with an incomplete environment
closed_items.evidence: 2026-08-06: an agent shell inherited TERMUX_WORKSPACE_PROFILE_LOADED=1 without COGENTIA_REGISTRY or the workspace roots. Sourcing the managed profile returned early, so Cogentia could not discover the authoritative registry in the JeanHuguesRobert repository. A focused fixture reproduces the stale-sentinel environment and verifies that sourcing repairs it.
closed_items.next_action: No further action; keep the focused profile regression test.

closed_items.title: Gateway semantic search called AI-router embeddings inline (IoC violation)
closed_items.evidence: 2026-08-12 audit (research/ioc_continuation_openai_path_audit_2026-08-12.md): contextSemanticSearch on query-embed cache miss called createQueryEmbedding (AI-router /v1/embeddings) on the public context path, unlike CLI semanticSearch which emits a continuation. Fix Bugs First / Agent-Resumable CLI: structural tools must not hide provider judgment. Fixed on cogentia main: cache miss emits semantic-search continuation; hybrid falls back to keyword; health flags semantic_requires_continuation=true; direct_query_embeddings_enabled=false. Supabase/Inox inline embed gated by COGENTIA_ALLOW_INLINE_EMBED_FULFILL=1. Tests: test-query-embedding-cache.js.
closed_items.next_action: Watch hybrid quality on fracta after deploy; pre-warm embeds via search-with --cache-query where semantic is required.
